title: Padikkal And Gaikwad Lead India A Squads For Australia A Series
excerpt: Devdutt Padikkal captains the multi-day side and Ruturaj Gaikwad the one-day team for the five-match Australia A series in Puducherry, September 22 to October 11 — full squads and schedule.
body:
• Devdutt Padikkal captains India A in the two multi-day matches against Australia A in Puducherry, with Sai Sudharsan as his vice-captain.
  • Ruturaj Gaikwad leads the one-day squad, with Padikkal as his deputy; the five-match series runs September 22 to October 11, all in Puducherry.
  • Hardik Pandya was named in the original one-day squad subject to fitness, then replaced by Suryansh Shedge; Vipraj Nigam and Naman Dhir also made way in updated squads, for T Vijay and Anukul Roy.
  • Australia A's one-day squad includes Sam Konstas, Josh Philippe, Spencer Johnson, Riley Meredith and Todd Murphy; the ODIs stream on JioHotstar with no live TV telecast in India.

Two captains for a five-match A-team series

The BCCI's Men's Selection Committee named India A squads for a home multi-format series against Australia A comprising two multi-day matches and three one-day games, all in Puducherry, with Devdutt Padikkal leading the red-ball side and Ruturaj Gaikwad captaining the one-day team. Padikkal doubles as Gaikwad's vice-captain in the one-dayers, while Sai Sudharsan is Padikkal's deputy for the multi-day matches, according to the squad announcements reported by CricTracker and Sporting News.

The series ran from September 22 to October 11: the multi-day games from September 22-25 and September 29-October 2, followed by one-dayers on October 6, 9 and 11. All five matches were staged in Puducherry, with the one-dayers at the Cricket Association Puducherry Siechem Ground starting at 9:30 am IST, Wisden reported.

Multi-day squad: Padikkal leads a Test-hopeful group

The multi-day squad blends established domestic performers with players on the edge of Test selection: Aman Mokhade, Ayush Pandey, Devdutt Padikkal (captain), Sai Sudharsan (vice-captain), Yash Rathod, Shaik Rasheed, Kumar Kushagra (wicketkeeper), Shams Mulani, Tanush Kotian, Tushar Deshpande, Anshul Kamboj, Praful Hinge, N Jagadeesan (wicketkeeper), Nachiket Bhute and V Vyshak, whose place was subject to fitness clearance.

For Padikkal and Sudharsan, the leadership roles continue a season in which both have been central to India's longer-format plans, and a strong series against a competitive Australia A attack is the standard route into the senior Test conversation.

One-day squad: Gaikwad, Patidar and a changing cast

The original one-day squad was: Priyansh Arya, Sai Sudharsan, Devdutt Padikkal (vice-captain), Ruturaj Gaikwad (captain), Rajat Patidar, Kumar Kushagra (wicketkeeper), Nishant Sindhu, Vipraj Nigam, Arshin Kulkarni, Arshad Khan, Naman Dhir, Hardik Pandya, Prabhsimran Singh (wicketkeeper), Gurjapneet Singh and Yash Thakur. Pandya's inclusion, subject to fitness clearance from the Centre of Excellence, was the headline selection, offering the all-rounder a route back to competitive cricket.

The squad that took the field for the ODIs differed in three places. Pandya was ruled out with a fresh calf injury and replaced by Suryansh Shedge; Naman Dhir, picked in India's T20I squad for the West Indies series, was replaced by Anukul Roy; and Vipraj Nigam made way for T Vijay in the updated list published before the one-day leg. Gaikwad linked up with the squad after India's 2-1 ODI series win over the West Indies, IANS reported.

Australia A and how to watch

Australia A's one-day squad was: Mahli Beardman, Nikhil Chaudhary, Ben Dwarshuis, Spencer Johnson, Sam Konstas, Nathan McSweeney, Riley Meredith, Todd Murphy, Mitch Owen, Josh Philippe (wicketkeeper), Tanveer Sangha, Liam Scott, Lachlan Shaw and Will Sutherland. Meredith and Sutherland joined the touring party as replacements for Jack Edwards, called up to the senior squad in South Africa, and Aaron Hardie, sidelined with a knee issue, according to Wisden.

For diaspora fans, the one-dayers streamed live on JioHotstar in India, with no live television telecast scheduled. A-team series rarely draw large crowds, but they are where selection arguments are settled: performances here, in identical conditions home and away selectors trust, have repeatedly been the final evidence for elevating players such as Sudharsan into senior squads.

Why this series matters

India A versus Australia A is the closest simulation of senior international cricket available below Test and ODI level — future senior opponents, professional attacks and four-day scoreboard pressure. With two captains appointed across formats, the BCCI also used the series to test leadership depth: Padikkal in the longer format, where he has captained Karnataka, and Gaikwad, a former India white-ball captain in waiting, in the 50-over leg. The full squads and schedule above are the reference point for following which of these names converts A-team form into a senior call-up next.
